home.hero_desc: We are SCDI, a community of students passionate about technology, development and research.
home.sobre_desc: We are a university scientific community that promotes research, informatics development and academic collaboration. Through our platform, we connect young talent with scientific and technological growth opportunities.
home.cta_desc: Connect with a vibrant network of scientific and technological minds.

quienes_somos.p1: The Scientific Society of Informatics Development (SCDI) is an academic and collaborative organization made up of students, teachers and professionals interested in the advancement of technology, science and innovation within the university environment. Our purpose is to create an ecosystem where knowledge, research and informatics development become fundamental pillars to drive young talent and actively contribute to digital transformation in higher education.
quienes_somos.p2: Through our technological platform, we provide our members with a comprehensive environment for active participation in scientific events, research projects, article publishing and more. Our system facilitates member management, activity registration, payment tracking, committee administration and smooth communication through automated notifications.
quienes_somos.p3: At SCDI we value academic diversity, which is why we offer different types of membership — from students to honorary members — each with access to tools and content tailored to their profile. We also have a public section, aimed at external visitors, where we share featured events, relevant publications and advances in our projects, thus promoting scientific outreach.
quienes_somos.p4: Our mission is to connect the restless and proactive minds of the university community, promoting collaborative work, continuous training and scientific production as pillars of our identity. By joining us, we not only share knowledge, but build a solid network of support and professional growth within an ethical, inclusive and technologically advanced framework.

planes.subtitulo: Select the plan that best suits your profile and start enjoying the benefits of our scientific society.

planes.publicar: Can publish scientific articles for distribution within the society.
planes.comentar: Can comment on other members' publications.
planes.no_proyectos: Cannot create projects or scientific events.
planes.corp_miembros: Can add and manage members of their corporation.
